From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Northwind — sizing recommendation (hosted vs dedicated)

Kim / Laura — reviewed Alex's matrix and sketched a recommended path. TL;DR: recommend Dedicated capacity with hosted fallback for extreme short bursts. Rationale and plan below.

Observations:
- Sustained 200 QPS with p95 goal 120ms for 13B models favors Dedicated for per-token cost and predictable latency.
- Peak sustained 1.2k QPS for 10–30m bursts is within Dedicated with autoscaling but requires careful warm-up (KV cache) and batching tuning.
- Absolute <2m 4k QPS spikes are better handled by short-term hosted capacity (burst to hosted) because keeping Dedicated sized for that is cost-inefficient.

Sizing recommendation (starting pilot):
- Pilot cluster: 8x A100-80GB equivalent GPUs (or 10x 48GB Ampere nodes depending on availability) configured as a Dedicated pool. This supports a quantized 13B at ~600–900 QPS steady with aggressive batching and KV cache; autoscale + burst reserve to reach sustained 1.2k by adding nodes during promo windows.
- Cache strategy: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated session tokens (expected to save ~30–40% token compute on storefront flows).
- Batching: continuous batching with a 15–25ms aggregation window for web traffic to hit latency targets at cost-effective throughput.
- Fallback plan: route overflow traffic to Hosted API endpoints in us-west/us-east as warm standby (policy: route if queue depth > X or if latency SLO violation).

Operational requirements / asks for Northwind:
- Customer-managed KMS (we will provide KMS integration checklist).
- SOC2 evidence & audit-log retention window (we can support standard audit logs; confirm retention periods).
- Model artifacts: provide model size and tokenization sample so we can finalize per-GPU throughput numbers.

Cost & pilot timeline (rough):
- 2-week Dedicated pilot (8 GPUs) + Hosted overflow enabled: back-of-envelope cost ~ $48k–$65k for the pilot depending on on-demand vs commit and model cpu/gpu memory usage. See attached back-of-envelope-costs.csv and a formal dedicated-sizing-proposal.pdf for two sizing variants.
- Deliverables: sizing workshop, pilot config, pilot runbook (SLOs/alerts), SLA/fallback routing policy.

Next steps I recommend we communicate to Alex:
1) Schedule 60-min sizing workshop with their infra + Dev (we can run a pre-flight check: sample tokenization/latency run).
2) Share the pilot SOW and the DocuSign envelope for approval.
3) During pilot, we run an A/B with quantized 13B and 7B to ensure cost/latency tradeoffs.

Happy to flesh this into a short slide with costs.

—Dev
